Senior Backend Engineer — Payments

Acme builds payment APIs for online marketplaces. You will design and own services that move money for 2,000+ marketplaces.

What you'll do:
- Design, build and operate backend services in Node.js and TypeScript
- Own the reliability of our ledger and payout systems
- Mentor engineers and lead technical design reviews

Requirements:
- 5+ years of backend development experience
- Strong experience with Node.js and TypeScript
- Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL)
- Experience designing distributed systems and event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar)
- Clear written communication; you write design docs
- Experience mentoring other engineers

Nice to have:
- Experience in payments, fintech or ledgering
- Familiarity with Kubernetes
- Bonus points for open-source contributions
